scope: Isolated fixtures, simulated uploads and print dialog, actual PDF generation and text extraction; no physical printing.
checks: PDF and printing actions require a selection and preserve the existing CSV formats
Heavy PDF libraries are not loaded merely by opening the selection page
The first and initially selected preview is a specimen with Max Mustermann and actual tournament metadata
The default doubles specimen uses Max Mustermann and Hans Dampf while retaining tournament discipline and age data
Placeholder preview preserves field tokens and static text without changing or saving the template
The designer shows real selected participant data without reloading the document
Desktop settings use a wider column while the portrait preview uses its available space and both action groups keep three buttons in one row
When all settings fit on screen the gray preview has the same height as the settings column
A smaller screen uses the maximum preview height even when only its upper part is initially visible
Scrolling pins the preview between the bars without changing its height or paper scale
A taller footer reduces the preview height without covering any part of the certificate
At the end of the settings column the preview may move above the header while retaining its full height and paper scale
Editing a single template saves small validated settings without changing the doubles template
A server with older placeholder validation explains the exact save rejection and required restart while preserving the draft and blocking output
Retry after updating the server resends the complete unchanged draft without a page reload
Increasing the field height moves preview text by half the increase while preserving its position and horizontal alignment
Visible preview glyph pixels are vertically centered for 1. Platz
Rasterized PDF glyph pixels are vertically centered for 1. Platz
Visible preview glyph pixels are vertically centered for multiline accented text
Rasterized PDF glyph pixels are vertically centered for multiline accented text
Font size uses the shared stepper with one-point and Shift ten-point increments while preserving fine values, geometry and the other template
Field position and dimensions use the same centimetre steppers and display existing physical values correctly
Fine centimetre entries save the correct millimetre geometry and remain correct after selecting another field
Field steppers and Shift-arrow keys use the same larger increments while retaining precise offsets and the other template
Copying a field preserves every setting, adds exactly 2 cm vertically and selects the saved copy without changing the original or other template
The copied text field can be edited independently while its source keeps its text and formatting
Undo separately restores edits to the copy and then removes only the copied field
Copying is disabled with a reason when the exact 2 cm offset cannot fit, without resizing the field or sending a save
Field selection sorts new fields top to bottom and equal-height fields left to right
Moving a field updates the selection order while retaining the selected field and document stacking order
The complete scaled preview settles after scrolling before a field is dragged
Dragging a text field saves physical coordinates while leaving the other template untouched
Unknown placeholders explain why PDF and print are unavailable
Correcting an invalid template retries the latest value and restores PDF generation
A PDF background is stored separately and determines the single-template page format
Landscape preview fits the visible space between the bars without stretching or overflowing the paper
Doubles preview contains a personal recipient and the correct partner
The second doubles participant has their own preview with the swapped partner
Doubles can use a different image background and page orientation
Copying a template is explicit and preserves an independent destination
Undo restores the distinct doubles design and its partner field
Upload failure retains the saved template and permits exporting the previous design
An unreadable PDF is rejected before upload without replacing the existing background
Centimetre margins define an asymmetric print area and preserve the other template and page background
Position and size display the same print area as the centimetre margins
Fine centimetre values remain valid and save without rounding to the larger increment
Step buttons change by a tenth of a centimetre and Shift changes by a full centimetre without losing fine offsets
Arrow keys use the larger increment and neither stepping method goes below the minimum or saves unchanged values
Moving the print-area origin shifts preview text while preserving its relative coordinates
Editing the position updates the equivalent opposite page margins
Full-width action spans the print area with a nonzero origin while preserving other field properties and templates
Both centering actions use the print area rather than the physical page
The viewport-sized print-area preview settles before its drag coordinates are measured
Dragging stays inside the print area and saves coordinates relative to its origin
A print area outside the page blocks PDF and printing without saving the invalid dimensions
Doubles store their own print area without changing the singles layout
PDF output creates one real page for every selected singles or doubles participant
Regular PDF export resolves real participants and both partner roles even while literal placeholders are previewed
Only an acknowledged PDF output updates export markers
A test PDF contains the selected preview recipient on one page and never marks disciplines as exported
Opening the print dialog creates no download or automatic export mark
Confirming print marks the actual printed batch even if the current selection has changed
Failed print confirmation can be retried without another print job
Acknowledged print confirmation clears the pending printed batch
Preview-only background saves independently for singles while preserving the paper preview and text positions
Preview-only PDF output omits the stationery background and keeps personal content and its original page format
Test PDFs also omit a preview-only background
Switching to doubles keeps its own output setting and its visible image background
Printing omits both PDF and image stationery backgrounds while preserving all six personal pages
Designer preview, three-button action rows and output fit without horizontal overflow at 1920x1080
Designer preview, three-button action rows and output fit without horizontal overflow at 1024x768
Designer preview, three-button action rows and output fit without horizontal overflow at 390x844
Designer preview, three-button action rows and output fit without horizontal overflow at 320x568
Designer preview, three-button action rows and output fit without horizontal overflow at 844x390
Uploading a background blocks output and navigation until the asset is stored
Reopening the workspace restores both saved designs, print areas and preview-only settings without replacing the document or speech service
Without an export selection the specimen preview keeps its fixed name and configured tournament texts, city and last-game date
Unfinished events preview known tournament participants and mark only the placement as an example while batch output stays unavailable
Doubles without results offer each real participant with their correct partner and tournament metadata
A test PDF uses the currently selected preview recipient, partner and tournament metadata without exporting open placements
A placeholder test PDF keeps all field tokens literal without editing the template, exporting placements or resolving tournament data
An empty tournament keeps the specimen and literal-placeholder options with actual configured title and city without inventing a game date
Edited tournament texts and explicitly blank city and second title update the fallback preview without invented replacements
The single specimen resolves today and its last-game date and offers neither the removed normal date nor a final-date token
The double specimen resolves today and its last-game date and offers neither the removed normal date nor a final-date token
The optional date filter stays available and shows the same planned dates as the document without changing its content
A regular PDF resolves each discipline last-game date and today on all real certificates despite the active literal-token preview
Literal preview and its test PDF preserve the current-date and last-game placeholders
A live schedule correction and group-only discipline update the last-game date without requiring a final
